records.en: What kind of tamagoyaki do you want, Kokoro?

records.en_original: The classic, huh? That might be good.

records.en: Let's try freezing some fruit next time we find some.

records.en: That's a great idea! Now we have something to look forward to.

records.en: Do you have any preferences for spices, Rena-san?

records.en_original: Not particularly, as long as it tastes good. But how about we try something sour?
records.en: Anything's fine as long as it doesn't taste bad.^00How about something sour?

records.jp: 酸っぱい卵焼き？
records.en_original: Sour tamagoyaki...?
records.en: Sour tamagoyaki...?

records.jp: 結構挑戦するね

records.en: Someone's feeling adventurous.

records.en: They say sour food is good when you're tired.^00Maybe it could work?

records.en_original: Hey Yuki, what kind of tamagoyaki do you want?
records.en: Hey Yuki, what kind of tamagoyaki do you want?

records.jp: あたしは辛くしたいかな！
records.en_original: I think I wanna make it make it spicy!
records.en: I think I want to make it spicy!

records.jp: 退屈な毎日に刺激をってね！！
records.en_original: Gotta keep things interesting around here!
records.en: Gotta keep things interesting around here!

records.jp: そうだ！　一個めっちゃ辛いの作ろうよ！
records.en_original: Ooh, let's make just one of them super duper hot and not tell anyone!
records.en: That's it! Let's make one super spicy!

records.jp: お、いいね！　おもしろそう！
records.en_original: Oh, nice! That's gonna be hilarious!
records.en: Oh, nice! That's gonna be hilarious!

records.jp: もう一度言うけど、出かける前に準備はしっかりね^00特に食料、不安なら余ってる材料で作っておくといいよ
records.en_original: I'm just gonna say it again, make sure you're well prepared before we leave. Especially food—you can make more with leftover ingredients to be safe.
records.en: I'll say it again: prepare properly before going out.^00Especially food—make some from spare ingredients if you're worried.

records.jp: わかってるってー、心配性だなあ伶那さん
records.en_original: Yeah, yeah, I know. You don't have to worry so much, Rena.
records.en: Yeah, yeah, I know. You don't have to worry so much, Rena-san.

records.jp: ピクニックに行くんじゃないんだから^00気を引き締めてよね
records.en_original: We're not going on a picnic, so don't scrimp on prep.
records.en: We're not going on a picnic.^00Stay alert.

records.jp: わかってるってー、心配性だなあ伶那さん
records.en_original: Yeah, yeah, I know. You don't have to worry so much, Rena.
records.en: Yeah, yeah, I know. You don't have to worry so much, Rena-san.

records.jp: ピクニックに行くんじゃないんだから^00気を引き締めてよね
records.en_original: We're not going on a picnic, so don't scrimp on prep.
records.en: We're not going on a picnic.^00Stay alert.

records.en_original: Officer Ao! Can you hear me?!
records.en: Officer Ao! Can you hear me?!

records.jp: 隊員？？^00っていうかチャットだから声聞こえないし
records.en_original: Officer?? And of course I can't hear you, we're texting!
records.en: Officer??^00Besides, this is a chat. You can't hear me.

records.jp: 直接話した方が早くない？
records.en_original: Wouldn't it be easier to just talk in person?
records.en: Wouldn't it be easier to just talk in person?

records.jp: なんか作戦中のスパイみたいでよくない？
records.en_original: This way is cooler! We're like spies on a secret mission!
records.en: This way is cooler! We're like spies on a secret mission!

records.jp: 話し声で敵に気づかれちゃうかもしれないし
records.en_original: Plus, if we talk in person, we might be noticed by the enemy.
records.en: Plus, if we talk in person, we might be noticed by the enemy.

records.jp: まあ、それは一理あるかも……
records.en_original: I guess you have a point there.
records.en: I guess you have a point there.

records.jp: そうそう灯籠だけどね
records.en_original: So yeah, about that lantern.
records.en: So yeah, about that lantern.

records.jp: 雨漏り直すのにこの辺来たじゃん？
records.en_original: We came here when we were trying to fix the leak, right?
records.en: We came here when we were trying to fix the leak, right?

records.jp: あの時材料見つけたところらへんにあったと思うよ
records.en_original: I think I saw it around where we found the materials for that.
records.en: I think I saw it around where we found the materials for that.

records.jp: へー、よく見てたね^00じゃあそっちに探しに行ってみよう
records.en_original: Whoa, great memory! Let's look around there, then.
records.en: Wow, you were paying attention.^00Let's go look around there.

records.en: Sorry, I didn't see the message.^00...Officer??

records.jp: なんか作戦中のスパイみたいでよくない？
records.en_original: Yeah! Like we're spies on a secret mission!
records.en: Yeah! Like we're spies on a secret mission!

records.jp: 何の用だったの？
records.en_original: So, what did you need?
records.en: So, what did you need?

records.jp: 灯籠のことを報告しようと思ったんだけど^00もう解決しちゃったからいいや
records.en_original: I was gonna tell you about the lantern, but it looks like you've worked it out already.
records.en: I was going to report on the lantern,^00but you've already solved it, so never mind.

records.jp: 向こうの世界の奥にいたやつ……強かったね。^00対策を練らないと
records.en_original: The demons deep in the Faraway are strong. We need to come up with a good strategy.
records.en: That thing deep in the Faraway was strong.^00We need to plan a countermeasure.

records.jp: なんか、ときどき強い攻撃してくるよね
records.en_original: Yeah, some of those attacks were crazy powerful.
records.en: Yeah, some of those attacks were crazy powerful.

records.jp: 構えを見たらしっかりガードしないとね^00一度隊列が崩れたらリカバリーが難しくなる

records.en: We need to guard when we see it readying an attack.^00Once our formation falls apart, it'll be hard to recover.

records.jp: 任せたよ
records.en_original: We're counting on you.
records.en: We're counting on you.

records.jp: はーい
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: って、私がやんの！？
records.en_original: Wait, me?!
records.en: Wait, me?!

records.jp: そういうの得意でしょ^00大丈夫、回復はしてあげるから
records.en_original: Yeah, you're the best at that. Don't worry, I'll keep you healed up.
records.en: You're good at that.^00Don't worry, I'll keep you healed.

records.jp: 今度は勝てたね。^00また苦戦しないように鍛え直さないと
records.en_original: Phew, we won this time. Let's train up so we don't have to go through that again.
records.en: We won this time.^00We need to train so we don't struggle again.

records.jp: 強かったですね……ココロトープの奥にいた敵
records.en_original: Phew, the demons deep in the Heartscape are strong...
records.en: The enemy deep in the Heartscape was strong...

records.jp: だねえ……^00技を受けたら動きにくくなったりしてさ
records.en_original: Yeah... It's hard to move once you get hit.
records.en: Yeah...^00Some of its attacks made it hard to move.

records.jp: なにかしら対策しないといけないねー……
records.en_original: We need to come up with some sort of strategy.
records.en: We need to come up with some sort of strategy.

records.jp: わたし、回復は得意なので、^00できるだけ皆さんのサポートができるよう頑張ります。
records.en_original: I'm good at healing, so I'll focus on supporting everyone as much as I can.
records.en: I'm good at healing,^00so I'll do my best to support everyone.

records.jp: 詩帆さんに負担かけすぎるのもアレだし^00使えそうな道具がないかも探してみるよ
records.en_original: But we shouldn't put too much on you either. I'll see if there's some kind of tool we can use.
records.en: But I don't want to put too much on you, Shiho-san.^00I'll see if I can find any useful tools too.

records.jp: はい。^00しっかり準備して……次は絶対に勝ちましょうね。
records.en_original: Thank you. Let's do our best to prepare so we can win for sure next time.
records.en: Yes.^00Let's prepare properly... and make sure we win next time.

records.jp: 今度は何とか勝てたね……
records.en_original: Seems like we pulled it off this time...
records.en: Seems like we pulled it off this time...

records.jp: はい。苦戦はしましたけど、勝てて良かったです
records.en_original: Yes. It was quite the ordeal, but I'm glad we managed to win.
records.en: Yes. It was quite the ordeal, but I'm glad we managed to win.

records.jp: 愛央隊員！　応答せよ！
records.en_original: Officer Ao, come in!
records.en: Officer Ao, come in!

records.jp: 辺りを調べてみてるんだけどさ
records.en_original: So I was looking around the area.
records.en: So I was looking around the area.

records.jp: 向こうの岸に渡れそうなルートがないっぽいんだよねー
records.en_original: And I don't think there's a way to get across to the other side...
records.en: And I don't think there's a way to get across to the other side...

records.jp: んー、かと言って泳いで渡るのも危なそうだしなあ
records.en_original: Hmm, swimming across would be dangerous...
records.en: Hmm, swimming across would be dangerous...

records.jp: どうにかして橋をかけたりできればいいんだけど
records.en_original: Maybe there's some way we could make a bridge or something.
records.en: Maybe there's some way we could make a bridge or something.

records.jp: 使えそうなものがないか探してみるしかないかなー
records.en_original: Guess we gotta hunt for something we can use.
records.en: Officer Ao! Do you read me?!

records.jp: 邪魔なやつら倒しつつさ
records.en_original: Taking down anyone who gets in our way, of course!
records.en: What are you talking about?

records.jp: あ、ごめん^00気付かなかった
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I didn't see this!
records.en: Ah, sorry!^00I didn't see this!

records.jp: 状況報告しようと思ったんだけど忘れたからいいや
records.en_original: I was gonna give you a status update, but I forgot what I was gonna say.
records.en: I was gonna give you a status update, but I forgot what I was gonna say.

records.jp: さっき戦ったモンスター、手ごわかったね。^00何か対策を練らないと
records.en_original: That demon was pretty tough. We need to come up with a strategy to beat it.
records.en: That demon was pretty tough. We need^00to come up with a strategy to beat it.

records.jp: 動きを止められてる間に一気に距離を詰められて……^00って感じだったね
records.en_original: It kept coming at us super quick...
records.en: We need to guard when it prepares a major attack.^00If our formation breaks, recovery becomes difficult.

records.jp: 攻められてる時は、回避に徹するのも手かもね
records.en_original: Maybe we could try dodging when that happens.
records.en: Maybe we could try dodging when that happens.

records.jp: それでチャンスができたら一気に畳みかける
records.en_original: That might give us an opening to launch a counterattack.
records.en: That might give us an opening to launch a counterattack.

records.jp: 攻め切れるようにもっと速く、強く動かないと
records.en_original: We'll need to move quickly and forcefully so that we can strike back in time.
records.en: We'll need to move quickly and forcefully so that we can strike back in time.

records.en_original: You get pretty into it when you talk about fighting, huh?
records.en: You get pretty passionate when you talk about fighting, Hinako-san.

records.jp: え、変だったかな……？
records.en_original: Sorry, was that weird...?
records.en: Sorry, was that weird...?

records.jp: いやいや、参考になるよ^00私も頑張らなきゃなー
records.en_original: No, no, not at all! It was all useful stuff. And it made me realize I gotta try harder!
records.en: No, no, not at all! It was all useful stuff.^00And it made me realize I gotta try harder!

records.jp: 何とかリベンジできてよかったね
records.en_original: I'm glad we were able to get our revenge!
records.en: I'm glad we were able to get our revenge!

records.jp: うん。でも、課題も色々見えてきた^00また鍛え直しだね
records.en_original: Me too. I've found more issues to work on, though. Let's get some training in before trying again.
records.en: Me too. I've found more issues^00to work on, though. Let's get some training in before trying again.

records.jp: おー、真面目……
records.en_original: That's our Hinako, always serious about fighting...
records.en: That's our Hinako, always serious about fighting...

records.jp: 望遠鏡作るのに必要なものって何がある？
records.en_original: So what do we need to make a telescope?
records.en: So what do we need to make a telescope?

records.en_original: Well, the lens, the body...and some smaller metal parts, I think.
records.en: Well, the lens,^00the body...and some smaller metal parts, I think.

records.jp: 持ち運ぶことも考えたら……^00軽くて丈夫な金属が欲しいところかな
records.en_original: Since we'll be carrying it around, a strong but lightweight metal would be best.
records.en: Since we'll be carrying it around,^00a strong but lightweight metal would be best.

records.jp: 金属かあ^00作ったことないよねー
records.en_original: Hmm... I've never made anything metal before.
records.en: Hmm...^00I've never made anything metal before.

records.jp: 図書室にもその手の本はなかった気がする^00誰か知ってたりしないかな
records.en_original: I don't think the library had any books on it. I wonder if anyone else knows anything?
records.en: I don't think the library had any books on it.^00I wonder if anyone else knows anything?

records.jp: んー……他の人にも聞いてみるかなあ^00詩帆さんとか、日菜子さんとか
records.en_original: Hmm, let's ask around. Like Shiho or Hinako.
records.en: Hmm, let's ask around.^00Like Shiho-san or Hinako-san.

records.jp: 負けた……今回の相手、手強かったね
records.en_original: We lost... That was a tough fight.
records.en: We lost... That was a tough fight.

records.jp: なんか、いきなり強い攻撃してきたよね
records.en_original: Right? Those powerful attacks came out of nowhere.
records.en: Right? Those powerful attacks came out of nowhere.

records.jp: 多分、自分の筋力を増強するような技を使ってる。^00ただ、代わりに動きが遅くなってた

records.en: I bet they're using some techniques to improve their strength,^00but that's made their speed drop.

records.jp: 伶那さんよく見てるね
records.en_original: You have a good eye, Rena.
records.en: You have a good eye, Rena-san.

records.jp: 上手くその隙をチャンスに変えられたら^00勝機はあると思う
records.en_original: If we can take advantage of that, we might be able to beat them.
records.en: If we can take advantage of that, we might be able^00to beat them.

records.jp: カウンター作戦ってことだね
records.en_original: So you're saying that our strategy should be to counter their attacks.
records.en: So you're saying that our strategy should be to counter their attacks.

records.jp: そういうこと^00次は絶対勝とう
records.en_original: Exactly. We'll win next time, I know it.
records.en: Exactly.^00We'll win next time, I know it.

records.jp: リベンジ成功！^00やったね伶那さん
records.en_original: Yay, we got our revenge! This is all thanks to you, Rena.
records.en: Revenge complete!^00We did it, Rena-san!

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.en_original: So, about my former teammates...
records.en: So, about my former teammates...

records.jp: 一つ思い出した事があるんです。
records.en_original: I remembered something just now.
records.en: I remembered something just now.

records.jp: お、なになに？
records.en_original: Ooh, what is it?
records.en: Ooh, what is it?

records.en_original: One time, everyone on the team hung out on a day off. I believe we went to a nearby festival.
records.en: One time, everyone on the team hung out on a day off.^00I believe we went to a nearby festival.

records.jp: お祭りかー
records.en_original: A festival?
records.en: A festival?

records.en_original: I do remember there being plans for a festival included in our ideas for the school makeover...
records.en: I do remember there being plans for a festival included in our ideas^00for the school makeover...

records.jp: はい。実際に作ってみれば、^00また何か思い出すかもしれません。
records.en_original: There was, yes. I think if we were to make it, I might be able to remember something else.
records.en: There was, yes. I think if we were to make it,^00I might be able to remember something else.

records.jp: あ、ごめん！　見てなかった！^00記憶って……
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I didn't see this. You were saying something about your memories...?
records.en: Ah, sorry! I didn't see this. You were saying something^00about your memories...?

records.jp: あ、はい。久野さんの事です。^00お祭りの思い出について話そうと思っていたのですが。
records.en_original: Oh, yes. It was about Kirara. I wanted to tell you about my memories of a festival.
records.en: Oh, yes. It was about Kuno-san.^00I wanted to tell you about my memories of a festival.

records.jp: 当たりだったね
records.en_original: Seems you were right on the mark.
records.en: Seems you were right on the mark.

records.jp: はい。
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 色塗る用の道具ってない？
records.en_original: Do we have any art supplies?
records.en: Do we have any art supplies?

records.jp: 絵の具とかってこと？^00何に使うの？
records.en_original: Like paints and whatnot? What for?
records.en: Like paints and whatnot?^00What for?

records.jp: 屋台とか作る時に^00せっかくならデザインにもこだわりたいなーって
records.en_original: I wanted to make some nice signs for our festival booths.
records.en: I wanted^00to make some nice signs for our festival booths.

records.jp: んー、あったかなあ
records.en_original: Hmm, I think we had some...
records.en: Hmm, I think we had some...

records.jp: あ、そういえば勇希ちゃんがペンキがどうとか^00言ってたような……

records.en: Ah, I remember Yuki-chan mentioning something about^00paints at some point.

records.jp: まーたなんか企んでるのかな……

records.en: What is she plotting now...?

records.jp: 一応話聞いてみるよ、ありがとね

records.en: I'll try asking her. Thanks!

records.jp: 愛央、おつかれ
records.en_original: Good job today, Ao.
records.en: Good job today, Ao.

records.jp: ごめん、負けちゃった

records.en: But we lost... I'm sorry.

records.jp: 戦闘中、みんな動き辛そうにしてた
records.en_original: Everyone seemed to have trouble moving in battle.
records.en: Everyone seemed to have trouble moving in battle.

records.en: Yeah, we kept getting hit by attacks with a numbing effect...

records.en: Paralysis, I see... Sounds tough.

records.en: We'll need to prepare a way to cure it.

records.jp: うん^00次は勝つよ

records.en: Thanks.^00We'll beat them next time for sure.

records.jp: 愛央、おつかれ

records.en: What's up?

records.en: About the other Reflectors...

records.en: I had this friend with Reflector powers.

records.en: Tell me more!

records.en_original: You were?
records.en: You were?

records.jp: 文化祭とか？
records.en_original: Like to their school festival or something?
records.en: Like to their school festival or something?

records.jp: 文化祭じゃないけど、でもお祭りっぽい感じだったかな^00季節は夏ごろで
records.en_original: Not their school festival, but it was a sort of festival-type event... I think it was in the summer.
records.en: Not their school festival, but it was a sort of festival-type event...^00I think it was in the summer.

records.jp: 夏のお祭り……^00わかった、それっぽいやつ作ってみよ！
records.en_original: A summer festival... All right, we'll make something that fits the bill!
records.en: A summer festival...^00All right, we'll make something that fits the bill!

records.jp: ごめん、気づかなかった！　どしたの？
records.en_original: Sorry, I didn't see this! What's up?
records.en: Sorry, I didn't see this! What's up?

records.jp: リフレクターの力を使える友だちがいたのを^00思いだしたからお話しようと思ったんだけど
records.en_original: I just remembered I had this friend with Reflector powers. I wanted to tell you about her.
records.en: I just remembered I had this friend with Reflector powers.^00I wanted to tell you about her.

records.jp: それって、陽桜莉さんたちのこと？
records.en_original: Are you talking about Hiori?
records.en: Are you talking about Hiori-san?

records.jp: うん。ちゃんと思いだせてよかったよ
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm so glad I remember now.
records.en: Yeah. I'm so glad I remember now.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん隊員、応答するのです！
records.en_original: Officer Ao, please come in!
records.en: Officer Ao-chan, please come in!

records.jp: あ、あれ？　勇希ちゃんから探索中は^00こうやってお話するようにって言われたんだけど
records.en_original: Huh? Yuki told me to talk like this while exploring...
records.en: Huh? Yuki-chan told me^00to talk like this while exploring...

records.jp: 勇希の入れ知恵かあ^00はいはい、愛央ちゃん隊員ですよー
records.en_original: So Yuki's gotten to you, huh... Okay, sure, this is Officer Ao.
records.en: So Yuki's gotten to you, huh...^00Okay, sure, this is Officer Ao-chan.

records.jp: どうかしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: ちょっと辺りを調べてみたけど、奥に進むには^00まわりのビルに飛び移らないといけないみたい
records.en_original: I took a look around, and it looks like we'll need to jump from building to building to proceed.
records.en: I took a look around, and it looks like we'll need^00to jump from building to building to proceed.

records.jp: 飛び移るって言ったってねえ……
records.en_original: Did you say jump?
records.en: Did you say jump?

records.jp: あと、変な色の標識がいっぱい立ってる
records.en_original: Also, there are a bunch of signs in...weird colors.
records.en: Also, there are a bunch of signs in...weird colors.

records.jp: 変な色？
records.en_original: Weird colors?
records.en: Weird colors?

records.jp: 「止まれ」って書いてある、緑とか、黄色とかのやつ^00ふつう、「止まれ」って赤い標識だよね？
records.en_original: Well, the signs say "STOP," but they're green and yellow. Aren't stop signs usually red?
records.en: Well, the signs say "STOP," but they're green and yellow.^00Aren't stop signs usually red?

records.jp: ああ、確かに
records.en_original: Mm, that's true...
records.en: Mm, that's true...

records.jp: 赤いのもあるみたいだけど^00赤に、黄色に、緑……信号機みたい
records.en_original: I mean, there are red ones too, but... Red, yellow, green—it's like a traffic light.
records.en: I mean, there are red ones too, but... Red,^00yellow, green—it's like a traffic light.

records.jp: 信号機……そういえば、大きな信号機もあったね^00何か意味があるのかな
records.en_original: Hmm... We did see a huge traffic light too, didn't we? I wonder if it all means something.
records.en: Hmm... We did see a huge traffic light too, didn't we?^00I wonder if it all means something.

records.jp: そのあたり、重点的に調べてみよっか
records.en_original: I'll prioritize searching that area.
records.en: I'll prioritize searching that area.

records.jp: あー、ごめん気付かなかった^00はいはい、愛央ちゃん隊員ですよー
records.en_original: Ah, sorry, I didn't see this! Yes, this is Officer Ao.
records.en: Ah, sorry, I didn't see this! Yes,^00this is Officer Ao-chan.

records.jp: どうかしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: ううん^00呼んでみただけ
records.en_original: Nothing. I just wanted to call you that!
records.en: Nothing.^00I just wanted to call you that!

records.jp: お疲れ様。ココロトープの奥で戦った相手……^00中々強敵だったわね。
records.en_original: Good work out there. The enemies deep in the Heartscape were quite powerful.
records.en: Good work out there.^00The enemies deep in the Heartscape were quite powerful.

records.jp: ごめんなさい^00二人のためにも勝ちたかったんだけど……
records.en_original: I'm sorry... I wanted to win for your sakes too.
records.en: I'm sorry...^00I wanted to win for your sakes too.

records.jp: 無事に帰ってこれたんだから十分よ。^00対策を練って、リベンジしましょ。
records.en_original: You made it out safely, that's the most important thing. Tighten up your strategy and try again.
records.en: You made it out safely, that's the most important thing.^00Tighten up your strategy and try again.

records.jp: どうやら、二体のコンビネーションで戦う敵みたいね。^00片方が妨害や支援に徹している感じ。
records.en_original: The enemies seemed to coordinate with each other, alternating between interference and support.
records.en: The enemies seemed to coordinate with each other,^00alternating between interference and support.

records.jp: そうそう^00サポート役を先に狙った方がいいのかなあ
records.en_original: Yeah. I'd say we should focus on taking down the supporting one first.
records.en: Yeah.^00I'd say we should focus on taking down the supporting one first.

records.jp: そうね。倒せないまでも、動きを止めておければ^00楽に戦いを進められると思うわ
records.en_original: I agree. Even if you can't defeat it, stopping its movements would help a lot.
records.en: I agree. Even if you can't defeat it,^00stopping its movements would help a lot.

records.jp: 陽桜莉はそういうの得意だと思うから、^00あの子にも頼ってみて
records.en_original: Hiori's good at that kind of stuff, so you can rely on her too.
records.en: Hiori's good at that kind of stuff,^00so you can rely on her too.

records.jp: 何とかリベンジ成功……
records.en_original: We pulled it off somehow...
records.en: We pulled it off somehow...

records.jp: 本当お疲れさま。
records.en_original: Good work, seriously.
records.en: Good work, seriously.

records.jp: 改造計画のアイディア^00いろいろ出してくれてありがとね
records.en_original: Thanks for all your makeover ideas.
records.en: Thanks^00for all your makeover ideas.

records.jp: どういたしまして！
records.en_original: You're very welcome!
records.en: You're very welcome!

records.jp: みんなでワイワイ考えるのすごく楽しかったよ
records.en_original: It was really fun coming up with them together.
records.en: It was really fun coming up with them together.

records.jp: リフレクターも次で最後の一人かあ……
records.en_original: We're finally gonna meet the last Reflector...
records.en: We're finally gonna meet the last Reflector...

records.jp: 私たちの知り合いの誰かなのかなあ？
records.en_original: I wonder if it'll be someone we know?
records.en: I wonder if it'll be someone we know?

records.jp: 今までは誰かの知り合いパターンばっかりだったけど^00どうなんだろうね
records.en_original: Everyone so far has been, but who knows?
records.en: Everyone we've met so far knew someone in the group,^00but I wonder if this one will too.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは思い当たる人いる？
records.en_original: Do you have any idea who it could be, Hiori?
records.en: Do you have any idea who it could be, Hiori-san?

records.jp: もしかしたら……って子はいるかも
records.en_original: Just an inkling...
records.en: Just an inkling...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんの提案してくれたアイディアが^00何かヒントになるかもね
records.en_original: The ideas you suggested might be a hint.
records.en: The idea you suggested, Hiori-san,^00might give us a clue.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん隊員！
records.en_original: Officer Ao!
records.en: Officer Ao-chan!

records.jp: 陽桜莉隊員、どうした！？
records.en_original: Officer Hiori, what's the matter?!
records.en: Officer Hiori, what's the matter?!

records.jp: このあたり、ところどころに変な草が生えてるよ
records.en_original: There's some patches of weird grass growing around here.
records.en: There's some patches of weird grass growing around here.

records.jp: 確かに^00見るからにアヤシイよね……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, they do look a little suspect.
records.en: True.^00They certainly look suspicious...

records.jp: 引っこ抜いたら何が出てくるんだろうねー
records.en_original: I wonder what'll pop out if we pull them up?
records.en: I wonder what'll pop out if we pull them up?

records.jp: ま、待ってー！
records.en_original: Wait!
records.en: Wait!

records.jp: 応答せよ！　愛央ちゃん隊員！
records.en_original: Come in, Officer Ao!
records.en: Come in, Officer Ao-chan!

records.jp: 陽桜莉隊員、どうした！？
records.en_original: Officer Hiori, what is it?!
records.en: Officer Hiori, what is it?!

records.jp: ココロトープの地面に怪しい草が！^00……って、もう抜いちゃった？
records.en_original: The weird grass in the Heartscape... Did you pull it all up?!
records.en: The weird grass in the Heartscape...^00Did you pull it all up?!

records.jp: なんか色々出てきてちょっと楽しくなってきた
records.en_original: Yeah... All kinds of stuff came out, so I got a little carried away.
records.en: Yeah... All kinds of stuff came out, so I got a little carried away.

records.jp: 星崎さん^00さっき戦ったやつの対策なんだけど
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, we should talk strategy for the fight just now.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san,^00we should talk strategy for the fight just now.

records.jp: ボスっぽい敵の周りにサポート役みたいのが^00いるんだよね
records.en_original: Yeah. There were a bunch of enemies around the boss-like one. I think they were providing support.
records.en: Yeah. There were a bunch of enemies around the boss-like one.^00I think they were providing support.

records.jp: うん。しかも、あまり攻撃が効いてる様子がなかった^00先に倒して……ってのは難しいかも
records.en_original: Right. But our attacks didn't seem to affect them at all. It might be tough to take them out first.
records.en: Right. But our attacks didn't seem to affect them at all.^00It might be tough to take them out first.

records.jp: どーすりゃいいんだろ
records.en_original: Gah, what do we do?
records.en: Gah, what do we do?

records.jp: 集中攻撃すれば動きを止めておくことはできると思う^00その隙に本体を叩くしかないかな
records.en_original: I think we can stop their movements with a focused attack, then use that chance to attack the boss.
records.en: I think we can stop their movements with a focused attack,^00then use that chance to attack the boss.

records.jp: 伶那さん、思ったより平気そうで安心した
records.en_original: Hey, Rena. You seem to be doing better than I expected. That's a relief.
records.en: Hey, Rena-san. You seem to be doing better than I expected. That's a relief.

records.jp: なに？　突然
records.en_original: Why do you say that?
records.en: Why do you say that?

records.jp: もう少しで勇希に追いつきそうだったのに^00やられちゃってさ……落ち込んでないかなって
records.en_original: Well, we were about to catch up with Yuki, but then... I just thought you'd be upset about it.
records.en: Well, we were about to catch up with Yuki, but then...^00I just thought you'd be upset about it.

records.jp: 全然。むしろ、早くリベンジしたくてウズウズしてる^00今度こそは……倒して勇希を捕まえる
records.en_original: Not in the slightest. If anything, I'm itching to try again. Next time...I'll get her back.
records.en: Not in the slightest. If anything, I'm itching to try again.^00Next time...I'll get her back.

records.jp: うん、がんばろ
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's give it our best.
records.en: Yeah. Let's give it our best.

records.jp: あーごめん！　気づかなかった！
records.en_original: Ah! Sorry! I didn't see this!
records.en: Ah! Sorry! I didn't see this!

records.jp: いいよ。ちゃんと倒せたし^00勇希も、戻ってきたし
records.en_original: Don't worry. We won, and Yuki's back.
records.en: Don't worry. We won,^00and Yuki's back.

records.jp: うん、良かった^00ちゃんと元通りになって
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm so glad she's back to normal!
records.en: Yeah, I'm glad.^00She's back to normal.

records.jp: 生きてる？
records.en_original: Are you still with me?
records.en: Are you still with me?

records.jp: 生きてる生きてる^00こっぴどくやられちゃったけど
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm still breathing. We took a beating, though...
records.en: Yeah, I'm still breathing.^00We took a beating, though...

records.jp: また厄介な敵が出てきたらしいな
records.en_original: That fight seemed like quite the ordeal.
records.en: Looks like another troublesome enemy appeared.

records.jp: なんか敵の攻撃を受けたら体が重くなってさ……^00傷を回復しようと思ってもなんかうまくいかなくて
records.en_original: Yeah. The attacks made my body feel heavy... I tried to heal my wounds, but it didn't really work.
records.en: Yeah. The attacks made my body feel heavy...^00I tried to heal my wounds, but it didn't really work.

records.jp: ふむ……きっと呪いのようなものだな
records.en_original: Hmm... It must be a curse of some kind.
records.en: Hmm... It must be a curse of some kind.

records.jp: 呪い？
records.en_original: A curse?
records.en: A curse?

records.jp: そう^00いわゆるカース
records.en_original: Indeed. And a troublesome one at that.
records.en: Yes.^00A so-called curse.

records.jp: 回復は聖なる力^00でも、邪悪な呪いにかかってしまっては効果が薄れる
records.en_original: As healing is a sacred power, the dark powers of a curse can nullify its effects.
records.en: As healing is a sacred power,^00the dark powers of a curse can nullify its effects.

records.jp: 聖なる力で呪いを打ち破る！^00っていうわけにはいかないのかねー
records.en_original: So we could use sacred powers to break the curse! ...Maybe?
records.en: So we could use sacred powers^00to break the curse! ...Maybe?

records.jp: もちろん、解呪する方法はある^00ただ、ちゃんとそれ専用の力なり道具なりを使わないと
records.en_original: It's not impossible. However, it requires certain powers or tools.
records.en: Of course there is a way to lift it.^00But you'll need a power or item specifically meant for that.

records.jp: なるほどね^00ちゃんと準備していかなくちゃ、か
records.en_original: I see... Well, we better prepare properly, then.
records.en: I see...^00Well, we better prepare properly, then.

records.jp: ぐっどらっく愛央
records.en_original: Good luck, Ao.
records.en: Good luck, Ao.

records.jp: 苦戦したみたいだが、勝てたみたいだな
records.en_original: That seemed like a difficult battle, but I'm glad you won in the end.
records.en: That seemed like a difficult battle, but I'm glad you won in the end.

records.jp: ひまわりが壁になってて向こうが見えないね
records.en_original: I can't see through all these sunflowers!
records.en: I can't see through all these sunflowers!

records.jp: まるで迷路だね……
records.en_original: It's like we're in a maze...
records.en: It's like we're in a maze...

records.jp: 高いところにのぼったら道がわかったりしないかな？
records.en_original: If we climb up something, would we be able to see the path from above?
records.en: If we climb up something, would we be able to see the path from above?

records.jp: 迷路の攻略法としては邪道かもだけど^00そこにこだわってる場合でもないか
records.en_original: That's not how you're supposed to solve a maze, but I guess now's not the time to worry about that.
records.en: It might be cheating as a way to solve a maze,^00but this isn't the time to worry about that.

records.jp: 何でも利用して奥に進もう
records.en_original: We have to use whatever we can to get through to the other side.
records.en: We have to use whatever we can to get through to the other side.

records.jp: 無事に抜けられたね
records.en_original: We made it out!
records.en: We made it out!

records.jp: うー、負けちゃったね……^00詩ちゃんのココロトープにいた敵、強かった
records.en_original: Ugh, we lost... The enemies in Uta's Heartscape were so strong.
records.en: Ugh, we lost...^00The enemy in Uta-chan's Heartscape was strong.

records.jp: 脇にいるやつらが厄介なんだよねえ
records.en_original: Especially the ones at the sides.
records.en: Especially the ones at the sides.

records.jp: 派手な攻撃でまとめてドーン！^00って攻められたらいいんだけどなあ
records.en_original: I wish we could use some flashy moves and just take 'em out like BAM! POW!
records.en: I wish we could use some flashy moves^00and just take 'em out like BAM! POW!

records.jp: 隙が大きいからタイミングは限られるけど^00狙ってみてもいいかもねー
records.en_original: There were a few big openings we could aim for. We'd have to get the timing just right, though.
records.en: Those attacks leave a big opening,^00so the timing is limited, but it may be worth trying.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんのためにも、次は絶対勝とうね
records.en_original: We need to win this one for Uta.
records.en: We need to win this one for Uta-chan.

records.jp: もちろん！
records.en_original: For sure!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: リベンジ成功！
records.en_original: Yessss, we got our revenge!
records.en: Yessss, we got our revenge!

records.jp: 愛央、いいかしら
records.en_original: Ao, is this a good time?
records.en: Ao, is this a good time?

records.jp: どしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: これから、皆のココロトープからフラグメントを^00回収していくのよね？
records.en_original: You're going to gather everyone's Fragments from their Heartscapes, aren't you?
records.en: We're going to collect Fragments^00from everyone's Heartscapes, right?

records.jp: うん^00世界を新しく作るために力がもっと必要だから
records.en_original: Yeah. We need more power to rebuild the world.
records.en: Yeah.^00We need more power to rebuild the world.

records.jp: フラグメントを回収するという事は、^00本人の心に触れることでもあるわ。
records.en_original: Ao, collecting Fragments also means touching that person's heart.
records.en: Collecting a Fragment^00also means touching that person's heart.

records.jp: そして、ココロトープに現れるモンスターは、^00心の歪みの象徴……
records.en_original: And we know that the demons that appear in the Heartscape are made of emotional distress...
records.en: And the demons that appear in a Heartscape^00symbolize distortions of the heart...

records.jp: 心の奥深くに触れようとするなら、^00より大きな歪みが起きてもおかしくないわ
records.en_original: So since you are treading deep into our hearts, you will likely encounter even greater distress.
records.en: If we try to reach deeper into someone's heart,^00it wouldn't be strange for a greater distortion to arise.

records.jp: つまり、前よりも強力なヤツが出てくるかもってこと？
records.en_original: So you're saying the enemies there will be even tougher?
records.en: So you're saying the enemies there will be even tougher?

records.jp: あくまで私の推測だけどね。^00入念に準備はしておいた方が良いと思うわ。
records.en_original: It's only an educated guess, but I believe so. I hope you will make sure to prepare yourself.
records.en: It's only my theory.^00But I think you should prepare thoroughly.

records.jp: あー、ごめん！　気づかなかった！^00何の用だったの？
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I didn't see this! What's up?
records.en: Ah, sorry!^00I didn't see this! What's up?

records.jp: フラグメントを回収する時に、今までよりも強い^00モンスターが出てくるかも、っていう話をね
records.en_original: I was going to say that even stronger demons would appear when you went to gather the Fragments.
records.en: I wanted to warn you that stronger demons^00might appear when you collect the Fragments.

records.jp: 実際出てきた……^00ちゃんと聞いとけばよかったなあ
records.en_original: And they did... I should've been paying attention!
records.en: And they did... I^00should've been paying attention!

records.jp: ふふ。何事も準備は大事ってことね
records.en_original: Hehe. Preparation is everything!
records.en: Hehe. Preparation is everything!

records.jp: はよ～ん☆^00何かお困りみたいだね？
records.en_original: Oh haaaay. Need anything?
records.en: Hayoon☆^00Looks like you're having some trouble?

records.jp: なんかデカいやつがいるー！！^00他にも敵がいっぱい！！
records.en_original: This thing is giant! And there's a ton of other enemies too!
records.en: There's a huge one!^00And a whole bunch of other enemies!

records.jp: リフナビ！^00アイツらを何とかできる便利な力とかない！？
records.en_original: ReSource! Do we have some kind of power that can take care of these things?
records.en: ReSource!^00Don't we have some convenient power to deal with them?!

records.jp: 今のキミたちじゃ倒すのはちょっと無理かな☆
records.en_original: I don't think you'll be able to beat them as you are.
records.en: You can't beat them as you are now☆

records.jp: やっぱり、見つからないように^00進むしかないんじゃないかなあ？
records.en_original: I guess that means we'll have to try and not let them see us.
records.en: Looks like our only choice^00is to move without being spotted.

records.jp: 倒すのは無理だけど^00その先に進むなら一つ良い事を教えてあげる♪
records.en_original: You may not be able to defeat any of them, but I'll let you in on something nice for sneaking past them!
records.en: You can't defeat them,^00but I can give you one useful tip for getting past♪

records.jp: キミたちの指輪には周囲のモンスターの^00気配を察知する力があるんだ☆
records.en_original: You can use your rings to sense if there are any demons around you!
records.en: Your rings can sense^00the presence of nearby demons☆

records.jp: モンスターの気配……？
records.en_original: Sense demons...?
records.en: The presence of demons...?

records.jp: 指輪に力を込めて集中してみて♪^00モンスターの気配や視線を感じられるはずだよ☆
records.en_original: By focusing your power to your rings, you can feel where demons are and where they're looking!
records.en: Focus and channel power into your rings♪^00You should sense the demons' presence and gaze☆

records.jp: あとはそれを避けていけばいい……って事？^00そんなに上手くいくかな
records.en_original: Which leaves it up to us to avoid them... I wonder if it's really that easy.
records.en: So we just avoid that...?^00Will it really go that smoothly?

records.jp: とりあえずやってみよう
records.en_original: Let's give it a try.
records.en: Let's give it a try.
